title: Site, Project, Authority & Construction Core

selection_basis.reduced_strict_order: MBES-01 → MBES-03 → MBES-05 → MBES-08 → MBES-12 → MBES-14 → MBES-18 → MBES-20 → MBES-24

objective: Implement the reduced MBES opening seam: workspace/resolution shell, stable owner-backed site/parcel/structure/space/component/network references, site/claim/permission projections, versioned construction Project/task bindings, proposal dispositions with stale-owner handling, MIB-13/ODL property/funding/procurement references, and Packet-07 preview/commit/recovery hooks without creating duplicate World, Project, property, market, contract, economy, or construction ledgers.
acceptance: Map or geometry context alone remains proposal-only and never grants construction authorization.
Valid owner-backed site permission plus current Project/resource requirements can produce a typed construction request without mutating owner state.
Revoked permission or stale site/Project/property/funding inputs invalidate preview or require revalidation rather than silently committing.
Stable site/parcel/structure/space/component/network references preserve owner identity across resolution scopes without creating duplicate World identity.
Property, funding and procurement are references/adapters to MIB-13/ODL/Economy/Project owners and are not copied into an MBES ledger.
Preview, commit and recovery dispositions preserve Packet-07 distinctions; preview is noncanonical and committed reversal is owner-defined compensation/recovery with history preserved.
Unsupported material/property/legal behavior remains unresolved rather than inferred.
Blocking construction planning is semantic/nonvisual, keyboard-capable, optional-AI independent and paid-cloud independent.
boundaries: MERA-24 and all upstream completed programs remain sealed.
World/Environment owners retain canonical site/world identity and condition truth.
MIB-13/Economy/ODL retain property, prices, markets, contracts, funding/procurement and economic truth.
MCS geometry is proposal/binding input and never becomes construction truth by itself.
MBES-01 creates no Project, property, market, contract, economy, Asset, World, or provenance ledger.
MBES-03 and later MBES tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MBES-01 closeout.
next_action: MBES-01 is completed_verified. MBES-03 — Material Requirements & Structural Build Assembly — is selected_not_started and requires a later owner Continue for governed start.
